get rid of something

phrase
Add to word list Add to word list
B1
to remove or throw away something unwanted:
That cream got rid of my skin rash.
I used weedkiller to get rid of the weeds in the garden.
If you have any clothes you want to get rid of, I'll take them off your hands.
Just rinsing your toothbrush won't get rid of the bacteria.
Give the lettuce leaves a shake to get rid of any excess water.
It's a great way to get rid of unwanted items without sending them to landfill.
B1
to sell an old or unwanted possession:
Have you managed to get rid of your old Volvo yet?
We've been trying to get rid of our timeshare for a while, but we've had no takers.
I don't want to get rid of that just yet - it was my mother's.
I have a whole garage's worth of tools to get rid of, so if you want the whole lot, make me an offer.

rid adjective
